messages:
Maya: Quick async check-in for SDKs / quickstarts / sample apps — what I did / blockers / today

Jonas: Did a pass on the Node quickstart, fixed the auth example (was using old header name). Pushed PR #482.

Priya: Reviewed #482, left small nits about error handling and retry example. +1 after that.

Alex: Working on Python sample app packaging. Blocker: CI's macOS build flakes on wheel build. Investigating; might pin pip/setuptools for reproducibility.

Maya: @Alex can you paste the failing command and gist of error? I can try locally.

Alex: Here's the failing command & error:
```bash
python -m build
ERROR: wheel build failed: exit code 1
OSError: invalid wheel filename
```
Not sure if it's our versioning logic or build backend.

Lina: FYI I hit a doc bug in the JS SDK reference — `client.generate` example uses `model: 'redwood/gpt'` but our catalog shows `redwood/gpt-1`. I'll open a tiny patch.

Maya: Thanks @Lina — if you add a quick changelog note I'll merge. Also, @Jonas please add a one-liner in the quickstart about setting REDWOOD_API_KEY env var (some early users missed it).

Jonas: Will do.

Priya: I can take the sample app e2e test flake once Alex narrows down commands.

Alex: Thanks. I'll try reproducing in a clean macOS runner and report back by EOD.

docs-bot: Reminder: doc linter job failed on main yesterday — see https://ci.redwood.dev/axe/422 for logs (:warning:)

Maya: Action items:
- Jonas: add env var note to Node quickstart (small edit)
- Lina: patch SDK reference (naming)
- Alex: dig deeper on wheel failure, share repro
- Priya: pick up e2e flake once repro is up

Any quick blockers besides CI flake? :wave:

Jonas: None from me.

Lina: None.

Priya: all good.

Alex: CI flake is the only blocker.

Maya: Great — thanks team. If anyone needs pairing ping me or drop a quick thread update. :thumbsup:
